groups.activity: pledge Arbiters of Hexis, run to round 8+, cash in Syndicate Alerts and Medallions
groups.meta: ~17 capped days at MR11, less at higher MR or with alerts

rows.label: Telos Boltace in the Maxim Offerings
rows.note: the rank-up gift can't be spent on it; budget the full amount separately

conditions: Each rank-up spends your standing down to zero and also costs a sacrifice: 500 Alloy Plate, 2 Gallium, 1 Forma, 1 Orokin Reactor and 5 Aya across the five promotions, plus 940,000 credits total. Have each ready before you hit its ceiling.
Standing caps at 132,000 once at Maxim; don't overshoot it while saving for the weapon.
bonuses: Elite Sanctuary Onslaught to round 8 and leave is the commonly reported fastest way to hit the cap, and it levels gear at the same time.

groups.activity: buy Telos Boltace from the Maxim Offerings

rows.label: Telos Boltace
rows.note: arrives as a finished weapon; no blueprint or Foundry step

conditions: MR 11 is required to purchase it.
bonuses: Telos Boltor (125,000 standing) and Telos Akbolto (100,000 standing) are the same syndicate's other Mastery pickups once you're at Maxim.
